proposed_widenings.name: grant_temperature_protection
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's second rider grants deterministic protection from extreme environmental cold to the wearer and carried/worn gear. That is not typed damage reduction, resistance, or damage immunity, and the current surface has no atom for environmental temperature protection.
proposed_widenings.evidence: while wearing this ring, you and everything you wear and carry are unharmed by temperatures of 0 degrees Fahrenheit or lower

notes: Authored the cold-damage reduction rider in content/magic_item_ring_of_warmth.dhall and generated JSON + trace successfully. Full pnpm typecheck is blocked by a pre-existing TypeScript error in src/interpreter/tracer.ts:3274 outside the allowed edit scope. The environmental-temperature clause was omitted from the authored payload and recorded as the widening.
